hero_kpi_rationale: Sphere is a capital-intensive asset in the ramp-up phase (opened September 2023). The high debt level of $830.4M represents the primary financial challenge and is the critical KPI for assessing the economic model's viability and capital structure.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total outstanding debt balance as of December 31, 2025, including the MSGN Term Loan Facility and other borrowings

kpis.name: Unrestricted Cash
kpis.description: Unrestricted cash available as of December 31, 2025. Includes $376.8M in advance ticket sale proceeds and excludes $30.5M of MSG Networks cash not available

kpis.name: Net Debt
kpis.description: Net debt calculated as total debt $830.4M minus unrestricted cash $507.8M, reflecting the adjusted leverage position

kpis.name: Sphere Las Vegas Opening
kpis.explanation: First operational immersive Sphere venue since September 2023
kpis.description: Sphere Las Vegas has been operational since September 2023 with multiple revenue streams: original immersive experiences, advertising partnerships, music residencies, and sporting events

kpis.name: Sphere Abu Dhabi Agreement
kpis.explanation: Franchise and partnership agreement for the development of Sphere Abu Dhabi
kpis.description: Finalized in July 2025, franchise, partnership, and pre-opening service agreements with DCT Abu Dhabi. Royalty model and operational service fees post-opening

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk on Debt
risks.score_rationale: Disclosed in Item 7A, risk quantified at $11.6M for 200 basis point increase. Measured language with direct impact on financing costs. Stable versus N-1. Medium weighting for capital risk.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk EUR/USD
risks.score_rationale: Presented in Item 7A, linked to Holoplot acquisition in Germany. Estimated impact $0.13M for 10% fluctuation. Factual language, new risk since 2024. Macro category weighted medium.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk GBP/USD
risks.score_rationale: Presented in Item 7A, linked to UK assets. Limited impact of $0.10M for 10% fluctuation. Stratford land sale in 2025 reduces exposure. Risk declining. Macro category.

risks.title: Technology Obsolescence Risk
risks.score_rationale: Implicitly addressed through intangible asset amortization periods and obsolescence risk. Central to asset valuation assessment. Cautious but recurring language. High criticality for SPHR's immersive technology platform.

risks.title: Intangible Asset Impairment Risk
risks.score_rationale: Detailed in Item 1A on impairment evaluation of amortizable assets, notably affiliate relationships. Quantitative and qualitative methodology described. Technical and cautious language. Industrial category critical.

risks.title: Pension Obligation Risk
risks.score_rationale: Detailed in Item 7A on actuarial assumptions (discount rates, expected returns). 25 basis point decrease increases obligation by $0.8M. Moderate but material impact. Capital category.

ai_positioning.summary: The company SPHR does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
